name: io.github.evidai/agent-payment
description: Non-custodial USDC micropayments for AI agents. Pay-per-call any HTTP API via one ERC-2612 permit (90 days, $25/day on-chain hard cap). x402-compatible. Demo mode works without signup.

environmentVariables.name: LEMON_CAKE_PERMIT
environmentVariables.description: ERC-2612 permit blob from https://lemoncake.xyz/start/v2. One signature gives a 90-day, $25/day on-chain hard cap. LemonCake never holds your USDC. Leave unset for Demo Mode (no charges, no signup).
